resources.string: Loan principal changes cash and debt, without counting as operating income or expenses. Record interest and fees as separate movements.
Goals reserve real money in a pocket. Contributions and withdrawals are internal transfers; your total balance is counted once. Spending from the pocket also updates its progress.
Track what you owe and what others owe you, with repayments linked to real movements.
Records the outstanding principal only. Your cash balance will stay unchanged.
Also creates the real cash movement in the selected account. Do not use this if you already registered the movement.
Already imported the receipt? Select a matching movement below to avoid recording the repayment twice.
The account or pocket must have the same purpose and currency as this debt.
Repayments keep their original movements. Reverse a repayment here to correct it before recording it again.
This reopens the outstanding principal. A movement created for this repayment will be removed; an existing imported movement will be unlinked and kept in your history.
Complete the required fields. Check the amount, currency, purpose and available balance. Repayments cannot exceed the outstanding principal.
The data changed or this movement is already linked. Close the editor and reopen it to use the latest values.
Authenticate to access your financial commitments.
Correcting the original principal also corrects the original cash disbursement. The principal cannot be lower than the repayments already recorded.
